composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-monorepo
composer.description: Vaulter — embeddable document management for Laravel: file manager, TipTap editor, versioning and real-time collaboration (monorepo dev workspace).

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-core
composer.description: Embeddable document management for Laravel — file manager, TipTap editor, version history and real-time collaboration, integrated through adapters.

suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Required only when using the 'spatie' host-role driver (^8.0).
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-filament: Filament admin UI for documents, folders and permissions.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-media: Content-addressed file/blob layer (CAS): the concrete ContentStore/StorageDriver/BlobStore engine behind the Contracts\Cas seam. Required for Drive file upload/download/versioning.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-drive: File/folder tree behaviour + resumable uploads: StorageManager, the DriveHandle factory, PurgeTrash/SweepUploads. Required for Vaulter::for()/forStorage() and the Drive REST surface.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-documents: Document-node behaviour: the format-handler registry, TipTap/export engines and real-time collaboration (Hocuspocus JWT minting needs firebase/php-jwt ^6.0). Required for Vaulter::registerHandler()/registerExporter() and the document REST surface.

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-azgard
composer.description: AzGuard permission bridge for Vaulter — a real AzgardGuard adapter delegating to AzGuard's scoped roles and workspace-context checks, so a host wires its ecosystem authorization into Vaulter's composite ACL with one binding.

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-media
composer.description: Content-addressed file/blob layer (CAS) for Vaulter — sha256 dedup, race-free commit, two-phase GC over Flysystem.

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-filament
composer.description: Filament 5 admin panel for Vaulter — manage documents, folders, share links and comments.

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-drive
composer.description: Drive behaviour for Vaulter — file/folder tree operations, storage manager and resumable uploads over the vaulter-core kernel and the vaulter-media CAS engine.

composer.name: axioma-studio/vaulter-documents
composer.description: Documents behaviour for Vaulter — TipTap document editing, version history and real-time collaboration over the vaulter-core kernel.

suggest.firebase/php-jwt: Required by the Hocuspocus collaboration driver to mint room JWTs (^7.0).
